# MeroRide

> MeroRide is a scooter and bike rental shop in Kusunti, Lalitpur, Nepal, serving Kathmandu Valley. Riders can book by WhatsApp or on the website.

## Main pages

- [Scooter rental in Kathmandu](https://meroride.com.np/scooter-rental-kathmandu): prices, required documents and available scooters
- [Blog](https://meroride.com.np/blog): rental and riding guides for Kathmandu Valley
